preconDecks.name: ARASAKA CONTROL // ALPHA KIT
preconDecks.description: The official Arasaka starter deck from Alpha Kit. A defensive control deck that uses high-power Units and Corpo agents to dominate the late game. Protect your Gigs with Blockers while building Street Cred for devastating effects.
preconDecks.strategy: Play defensively early. Use Blocker units like Corpo Security to protect your Gigs from direct attacks. Build your board slowly with mid-cost Units. Once you hit 12+ Street Cred, activate powerful triggered effects. Goro Takemura and Adam Smasher provide strong late-game pressure.
keyCards: Goro Takemura (Legend - Defensive utility, protects Units)
Adam Smasher (Legend - High Power, intimidation factor)
Corpo Security (Blocker - Your main defensive tool)

preconDecks.name: MERC AGGRO // ALPHA KIT
preconDecks.description: The official Merc starter deck from Alpha Kit. An aggressive rush strategy focused on stealing Gigs fast. Deploy cheap Units, equip powerful Cyberware, and attack relentlessly before your opponent stabilizes.
preconDecks.strategy: Go fast. Play 1-3 cost Units immediately. Equip them with Mantis Blades or Gorilla Arms to boost Power. Attack the opponent directly every turn to steal multiple Gigs. Jackie Welles can GO SOLO for instant attacks. Don't worry about losing Units - speed is everything.
keyCards: Jackie Welles (Legend - GO SOLO ability for instant attacks)
Panam Palmer (Legend - Nomad synergy and mobility)
Mantis Blades (Gear - +3 Power, game-ending on fast Units)
Rapid Strike (Program - Ready a Unit for double attacks)
